name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: A standard template for general meetings, focusing on key outcomes and actions.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the entire meeting.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: List the most important decisions made during the meeting.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks as bullets with an owner and due date only when explicitly stated. Do not invent an owner, date, transcript reference, or timestamp.
sections.item_format: - Owner: <name or Unassigned>; Task: <task>; Due: <date or Unspecified>

sections.title: Risks
sections.instruction: List concrete risks raised in the meeting. Use bullets and omit this section content when none were discussed.

sections.title: Blockers
sections.instruction: List active blockers or impediments discussed in the meeting. Use bullets and omit this section content when none were discussed.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List unresolved questions explicitly raised in the meeting. Use bullets and omit this section content when none were discussed.

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the main topics of discussion, key arguments, and important insights.
